vocabulary.definition: a state of consciousness in which you are not completely aware or in control
vocabulary.example: During meditation, she entered a deep trance and felt at peace.
He was so suggestible that he believed everything his friends told him.

vocabulary.definition: become so engrossed in something that you are unaware of time passing
vocabulary.example: She was so absorbed in the novel that she didn't realize hours had passed.

vocabulary.definition: become involved in a situation that you don't want to be in
vocabulary.example: She tried to avoid drama, but somehow she got sucked into the argument.

vocabulary.definition: the ability to hone in on something and give it your full attention
vocabulary.example: His intense concentration on the task at hand helped him complete it successfully.

vocabulary.definition: to have your attention completely fixed so that you cannot think of anything else
vocabulary.example: The audience was mesmerised by the magician's performance.
